stories.title: PS5 Games on Sale for $15 for Black Friday

sources.name: IGN
sources.title: PS5 Games on Sale for $15 for Black Friday
sources.text: In the olden days (a few years ago) you had to wait until the actual day of Black Friday before the killer deals would crop up. Those days are officially gone. Today, on the Monday before Black Friday official, Walmart kicked off its “ Black Friday Event 2 ,” dropping some absolutely killer deals, and Amazon is price matching most of them. Among the discounts are a bunch of PS5 games on sale for just $15. These games are excellent and not that old. So grab what you want, because you’re not likely to find them cheaper any time soon. What games are we talking? For starters, Mafia: The Old Country, an excellent single-player game that came out last year that our reviewer called “an effective return to the linear and tightly story-driven format of the original Mafia and Mafia II.” Then there’s Assassin’s Creed Shadows , in which Ubisoft’s long-running series finally goes to Japan. We gave it an 8/10 in our review , saying, “By sharpening the edges of its existing systems, Assassin’s Creed Shadows creates one of the best versions of the open-world style it’s been honing for the last decade.” Then there’s Borderlands 4 and Star Wars Outlaws and WWE 2K26, all fine games worth checking out if you haven’t already. Fifteen bucks will even get you Elden Ring, Fromsoft’s sprawling, open-world masterpiece that we gave a 10/10 in our review when it came out in 2022. That same year, we awarded it Game of the Year . Other all-time low prices can be had now as well, like AirPods Pro 3 for $149 and Metal Gear Solid Master Collection Vol 2. for $29.99 . Chris Reed is a senior commerce editor and deals expert for IGN. He also runs IGN's LEGO coverage and maintains the upcoming release dates articles for video games , LEGO sets , and 4K Blu-rays . You can follow him on Bluesky .

sources.title: The PS5 controller Black Friday deals are plentiful over at Currys
sources.text: The Wolverine model is also seeing a discount right now If you've been looking to pick up a new DualSense Wireless Controller for your PS5 in the Black Friday sales, then you'll have noticed that the discounts are quite uneven. While most retailers are discounting the extras to roughly the same £43 price point, the actual models of controllers reduced vary wildly by store. There seems to be an exception, though. The Currys PlayStation Black Friday sales have struck a wide array of color models for DualSense controllers; the selection is much more varied than Amazon's, with colorways reduced that aren't discounted elsewhere. That includes the DualSense's premium versions, like the sought-after Icon Blue retro model, as well as the perhaps controversial yellow-and-black Wolverine limited edition controller. Currys' PS5 DualSense controller discounts match other retailers', but with much more selection. By my count, eight different colorways are reduced from the eleven stocked at the retailer, including the vibrant pink and camo-patterned models, as well as some standard alternatives. Some of Sony's more premium DualSense colorways are seeing discounts too: the Icon Blue and Wolverine Limited Edition models are among them. These function the same as the normal models, but with more unique designs. Not only are they not on sale at rival retailers, but some don't even stock them at full price. If you buy one of these controllers from Currys, you get an additional benefit which we'll loosely chalk up as a 'Black Friday extra'. Currys is offering two months of Apple Music, Apple Fitness+, and Apple Arcade to people who purchase one of a selected range of products, which includes the DualSense controllers. This is for new or returning subscribers to those services, and when you make the purchase, you should receive a code in your inbox. The premium DualSense controllers are functionally identical to the standard ones. Don't buy one and expect to suddenly get better at your favorite game. The real reason to buy one is to celebrate your fandom of whatever the controller is inspired by. If you loved the Wolverine game earlier this year (or, more realistically, the character), that controller might be a fun one to add to your collection. Icon Blue was part of a series Sony put out about a year ago, celebrating the cerulean tone which is closely associated with the PlayStation brand, but it was pretty hard to find stock of when it first launched. Unfortunately, other limited edition DualSense colorways aren't seeing the same level of discounts at Currys, but are a bit more affordable than their launch prices of £74.99. For example, the 007 First Light controller isn't officially reduced with a Black Friday discount, but it is sitting at £56 at the retailer . Meanwhile, Amazon has it listed for £87.99. Other limited edition DualSense colorways at Currys under that £74.99 price include the Chroma, Pearl, and Remix versions. Unsurprisingly, the GTA 6 model isn't seeing any kind of price reduction at the moment. If you're worried about buying a controller now, thinking they could get cheaper in the coming week of sales, I'd imagine that's unlikely. Most retailers reduce DualSenses to the same price each year, and we're already seeing multiple hit this £43 mark; it seems that's where they'll stay. We're keeping tabs on all the best Black Friday deals for gamers , which includes all the Black Friday PS5 deals worth going for. And if you need a PS5 controller but don't feel like you need to stick to a DualSense, we've got a round-up of the best PS5 controllers you can buy. sources.name: PlayStation Blog BR
sources.title: Agradecemos por tornarem Grand Theft Auto VI o maior lançamento da história PlayStation
sources.text: Uma homenagem à comunidade PlayStation e à Rockstar Games por proporcionarem um momento incrível para o universo dos games e do entretenimento. Após uma longa espera, os jogadores finalmente tiveram a chance de mergulhar em Grand Theft Auto VI . Foi incrível ver a comunidade PlayStation ao redor do mundo começar suas aventuras no estado de Leonida. Quer você tenha contado os dias para retornar às ruas de Vice City, ou esteja vivenciando a série Grand Theft Auto pela primeira vez, queremos aproveitar este momento para agradecer. A empolgação e a paixão da comunidade tornaram este um momento verdadeiramente especial para todos nós. O lançamento de GTAVI marca um momento extraordinário para os jogos e o entretenimento, tornando-se o maior lançamento de um jogo na história de PlayStation, ao longo de três décadas e cinco gerações de consoles. Mais de 39 milhões de jogadores únicos vivenciaram a história de Jason e Lucia em Grand Theft Auto VI para PlayStation 5. A comunidade PlayStation se uniu de forma expressiva para vivenciar Grand Theft Auto VI durante seu lançamento e fim de semana de estreia. Confira alguns destaques do período de lançamento, encerrado em 22 de novembro de 2026*: Estas são apenas algumas das maneiras pelas quais vimos nossa comunidade PlayStation se unir em torno deste momento incrível no mundo dos jogos, e estamos empolgados para ver como vocês continuarão criando e compartilhando novas memórias e experiências nos próximos meses. Por fim, gostaríamos de parabenizar nossos parceiros da Rockstar Games por trazerem este jogo extraordinário a jogadores de todo o mundo e por darem continuidade a uma parceria com a PlayStation que vem desde o Grand Theft Auto III, para PlayStation 2. Com GTAVI, trabalhamos para oferecer a melhor experiência no console PS5 e proporcionamos aos jogadores uma forma memorável de celebrar o título, por meio de dois controles sem fio DualSense de edição limitada, inspirados em Vice City. Também celebramos o lançamento com eventos ao vivo, incluindo o “Grand Theft Auto VI: The Festival”, realizado em Miami no último fim de semana. E à nossa comunidade PlayStation, obrigado pela paixão e pelo apoio contínuos, e por escolherem vivenciar GTAVI no console PS5 . É o entusiasmo de vocês que torna momentos como este tão significativos para todos nós. Mal podemos esperar para ver aonde suas aventuras em Leonida levarão vocês! *Todos os números baseiam-se em dados internos da SIE coletados de 19 de novembro de 2026 a 22 de novembro de 2026.

sources.name: Gematsu
sources.title: Grand Theft Auto VI for PS5 tops 39 million players
sources.text: More than 39 million unique users have played Grand Theft Auto VI on PlayStation 5 as of November 22, making it the biggest launch in PlayStation history across three decades and five console generations, Sony Interactive Entertainment announced . The sequel set a new record for the highest number of concurrent players for any game on PlayStation, surpassing previous records across multiplayer, free-to-play, and single-player titles. Across PlayStation 5, players cumulatively logged 683 million hours of gameplay in Grand Theft Auto VI , and have spent an average of 17.4 hours exploring the game’s world during its opening days. Grand Theft Auto VI ‘s launch also marked the largest number of newly connected PlayStation 5 consoles on a single day since the console’s launch, outside of end-of-year holidays. Since launch, it was the first played game on 70 percent of new PlayStation 5 consoles. “We want to congratulate our partners at Rockstar Games for bringing this extraordinary game to players around the world and continuing a partnership with PlayStation that stretches back to Grand Theft Auto III on PlayStation 2 ,” Sony Interactive Entertainment content communications manager Tim Turi said. “With [ Grand Theft Auto VI ], we worked to bring the best experience on [PlayStation 5] and gave players a memorable way to commemorate the game with two special limited-edition DualSense wireless controllers inspired by Vice City. We also celebrated the launch with live events including Grand Theft Auto VI : The Festival in Miami this past weekend.” Grand Theft Auto VI launched for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series on November 19. On November 20, Rockstar Games announced that the game achieved $3.79 billion in day one retail sales following 32.5 million pre-sales. Although Rockstar Games did not share exact unit numbers, the revenue total suggests roughly 37.9 million to 47.3 million copies sold, based solely on pricing across its $79.99 and $99.99 editions.

sources.title: God of War Laufey's Faye actor jumps from games to live-action, as Amazon casts Deborah Ann Woll in upcoming series
sources.text: After appearing in both God of War Ragnarok and next year's God of War Laufey, Deborah Ann Woll is about to reprise her role as Faye in Amazon Prime Video's upcoming live-action series. Variety reports that the God of War cast list is now welcoming a second actor pulled straight from Sony Santa Monica's video game series. Deborah Ann Woll first showed up in the games as Kratos' wife and Atreus' mother during God of War Ragnarok, but she's also about to enter the spotlight proper in God of War Laufey. Amazon's God of War cast now includes Dave Bautista (Guardians of the Galaxy) as god killer Kratos, Callum Vinson (Chucky) as Atreus, Mandy Patinkin as Odin and Ólafur Darri Ólafsson as Thor. Alastair Duncan is also making the game-to-show jump by stepping back into the figurative shoes of chatty head Mimir. Earlier in the year, the God of War show halted production when former Kratos actor Ryan Hurst suffered an on-set injury. Bautista soon took over the role and production began again in October - all of Hurst's scenes had to be reshot, of course. There's no release date yet for the show, but it's said to follow the Norse era of the games which began in 2018's more serious and stern revamp. Amazon ordered a two-season run for the show, which apparently means both seasons will be filmed back-to-back. Meanwhile, God of War Laufey was recently delayed from February 2027 to May 2027, giving the PS5 exclusive slightly more breathing room away from Fable, Persona 4 Revival and Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis. "We will make the most of each moment until then by putting in the finishing touches and pushing the game to its fullest potential," developer Sony Santa Monica said at the time. "On behalf of everyone on the team, we appreciate your patience and we'll be back to share more updates soon." While the game puts Faye in the leading role as she battles with gods in a multi-mythological afterlife, the studio was quick to note that her journey isn't considered a side game. God of War Laufey will still connect to future games in the series and, yep, Kratos will eventually be back , too. "Genuinely, I thought I was going to be much more offended by it, but one, I'm not on social media, so that helps, and two, I don't know, I feel totally unbothered," Woll said of the online trolls who were targeting Laufey after its reveal this summer. "Because I just know it's great. It's okay if it's not your cup of tea, but in no universe is it bad."

sources.title: How to Play Grand Theft Auto VI in the Cloud and with Remote Play
sources.text: Grand Theft Auto VI supports XBOX Cloud Gaming , making it available to play even without a current-gen console. With XBOX Cloud Gaming, you can play by streaming it straight from the cloud to your XBOX One, or XBOX Series X|S if you’d like to save some hard drive space. Select Game Pass plans include a monthly allotment of up to 15 play hours, and you can buy more cloud playtime if you need it, giving you the opportunity to experience one of the biggest games of the year on the consoles you already own. The game uses XBOX Series S graphics settings when cloud-streamed with XBOX Cloud Gaming. You can also access Remote Play to enjoy Grand Theft Auto VI wherever you want to play , allowing you to stream gameplay directly from your XBOX Series X|S console to devices you already own, like your mobile phone, laptops, PCs, or even a handheld gaming PC like the XBOX ROG Ally. Here’s how to get these features up and running (a copy of Grand Theft Auto VI from the XBOX Store is required): To start your Cloud gaming session in Grand Theft Auto VI , you can use the controllers that are connected to your console following these steps: When possible, connecting a wired Ethernet cable is the best option for gaming quality. FYI, even wireless networks with high bandwidth can occasionally have a dip in audio and video quality. Remote Play allows you to stream gameplay from your XBOX Series X|S to devices you already own, like mobile devices, PCs, and handheld gaming PCs. Here’s how to enable it: Once you’ve completed those steps above, you can move forward with Remote Play on one of your devices: Whether you’re streaming from the Cloud to save space or picking up right where you left off on your handheld PC, XBOX Cloud Gaming and Remote Play give you more ways to play Grand Theft Auto VI on the devices you already own. For more info, visit XBOX Cloud Gaming and Grand Theft Auto VI on the XBOX Store.

sources.title: How to get the GTA 6 BF Bandito
sources.text: You won't find the BF Bandito in a lock up in GTA 6, as this vehicle heist is a little tricker to pull off While you're out stealing cars for Moses, the GTA 6 BF Bandito will appear on your list, taking you out to the very rural roads of South Leonard County and the Buckskin Swamp. This GTA 6 heist is slightly harder than the others you might have carried out so far though, as this car will be on the move. Like all of Moses' targets, the rough location of the BF Bandito is marked on the map, but as you make your way there, you'll pass by some whoopin' and hollerin' country dwellers who are already taking the buggy for a spin. Here's how to get your hands on the GTA 6 Bandito and get paid. The map marker will take you to the rough location of the BF Bandito, where you should keep your eyes and ears open for some locals riding around the swamps on buggies - one of these is the Bandito. To claim it for yourself, you'll need to stop the Bandito driver, and there are a few ways to do this. If you clock him fast enough, particularly when crossing water, you can simply get in front of him, and he'll stop. Otherwise, you can chase down the Bandito, shooting the driver and his pals. Weirdly, though, when I did this challenge, the driver eventually just stopped and bolted, leaving the buggy free for me to take, though I'm not sure exactly what triggered him to do this. Essentially, just stay close, don't destroy the car by shooting it too much, and it'll be yours in no time. sources.title: Wave Race Blue Storm is the 12th GameCube game to be added to Switch Online’s library
sources.text: It’s the first time Nintendo’s racing sequel has been re-released in 25 years Nintendo has added a 12th title to the GameCube library on Nintendo Switch Online. Wave Race: Blue Storm is the latest game which can be found in the console’s Nintendo Classics: GameCube app, which is available as part of a Nintendo Switch Online + Expansion Pass subscription. A launch title for the GameCube when it was released in late 2001, Wave Race: Blue Storm is the third game in the Wave Race series, after the Game Boy original and its iconic sequel Wave Race 64. Success in its races involve navigating between red and yellow buoys, which builds up the player’s turbo meter and makes it possible to get speed boosts. The game also had a cheat code which let you unlock a sarcastic announcer who would insult the player all the time. Some of his comments can be heard in the new trailer for the Switch 2 release, seen below. sources.title: How to steal the Declasse Vamos in GTA 6
sources.text: Grab the code to unlock the garage and steal the car for Moses. The Declasse Vamos is one of the many cars Moses asks you to steal for him in GTA 6 , but like the BF Bandito , it's a little trickier than just grabbing it. When you reach the map marker, you'll realise the car is locked in a garage that requires a specific code to open it. The code to the door is 2727 and this is fixed. The way you discover this is by sneaking inside the trailer and looking at the number plate on the wall to the left of the window, just above the guy snoozing in the chair. Enter the code to open the garage, break in with the slimjim, then hit the button to open the door. I personally incapacitated all of the people behind the trailer, so chances are they will pursue you or start shooting if you don't, once you try to drive out of there. Now take the car back to Moses, being careful on the way, to earn $4,100ish for top condition. sources.title: How to steal the Schafter V12 in GTA 6
sources.text: Prove yourself to Raul by yoinking this car. Stealing the Schafter V12 in GTA 6 is one of the car theft missions you'll have to complete to gain Raul's trust, but similar to the BF Bandito or Declasse Vamos , it's a little tricky. Make sure to grab the silenced pistol from the trunk of the car outside—not necessarily because you'll need it, but because it's a handy weapon to have. Now, as you can see in the video above, you can get into the chop shop by climbing up the van around back and then onto the roof. I'd then suggest dropping down on the right side, where there are few enemies, knocking out the guy sitting by the gate, then opening it by hitting the left button. Sneak back towards the centre of the chop shop and turn left to find the Declasse Vamos, a black unassuming car. Hop inside, start it up, and drive out of the gate you just opened. Easy, right? Now simply bring it to Randy's garage as directed. You also kill everyone inside if you wish, but my way above will get you that non-lethal Criminal Profile rating. sources.title: GTA 6 Car Service walkthrough: How to steal the Schafter V12
sources.text: Wondering how to steal the Schafter V12 in GTA 6? In this GTA 6 Chapter 3 mission, Lucia steals a luxury car from a gang-run chop shop and delivers it to one of Raulâs contacts. This mission also introduces you to Randy, a new vehicle drop-off point. Here’s everything you need to know about completing Car Service in GTA 6, including how to find the Schafter V12, escape the police and earn your reward. Need even more GTA 6 guides for Chapter 3 of Grand Theft Auto 6 ? Then check out our GTA 6 Guide Hub . Guides: If you're playing Grand Theft Auto 6, make sure to checkÂ out ourÂ complete walkthrough hub , featuringÂ beginner tips , navigation experience explained , GTA 6 cheats , and more. In GTA 6, Car Service becomes available after completing the Meet the Heders mission . Once you’ve finished, wait approximately one in-game day for a message from Raul. You’ll then receive a new mission marker in Vice City, where Lucia is tasked with stealing a Benefactor Schafter V12 from a gang hideout. Before entering the chop shop, look for a nearby vehicle with equipment stored in its trunk. Inside, you’ll find a silenced Klose K17 pistol and flash grenades. The silenced pistol is perfect for this next section, as the chop shop is pretty open plan, and thus difficult to stealth through. Head towards the compound and look for a white van. Climb onto its roof to access the metal roofing surrounding the yard.Â From here, you can survey the area and keep an eye on the gang members guarding the entrance. Be careful around the dog near the gates, as attacking it unnecessarily can negatively affect your criminal profile. The car is parked underneath the covered section in the middle of the chop shop, next to a small room. If you want to verify it’s the correct car,Â you can scan it with the WAINK app. Head towards the vehicle, deal with any remaining guards and get behind the wheel. Drive out of the compound and escape the area. You don’t actually have to take out the guards, you can just leave with the car, but taking out the guards makes it much easier, and doesn’t risk destroying the car, which will fail the mission. Once you’ve escaped, follow the GPS route to Leonida Auto World, where Randy is waiting.Drive into the dealership’s parking area to trigger the final cutscene and complete the mission. The reward for completing Car Service earns you $3,000 and unlocks Randy as a vehicle drop-off point. He can purchase certain vehicles you bring him, including cars with standard trackers and vehicles on his request list.

sources.title: Acts of Blood for PC delayed to spring 2027
sources.text: Publisher Big Fan Games and developer Eksil Team have delayed beat ’em up action game Acts of Blood from its previously planned December 4, 2026 release to spring 2027 for PC via Steam and Microsoft Store . PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series versions are also due out in 2027. Here is the full message from Eksil Team on the delay: With heavy heart we’re making a difficult decision to postpone the release of the game on PC (Steam) into spring 2027. We know the decision might disappoint for you, whom already looking forward to play our game on December. But after assessing the feedback we got from players, play testers, and internal team, we found several issues that still can be improved with a little bit more time, and hopefully it will deliver the best experience we intended.

sources.title: Does GTA 6 Have Darts or Bowling?
sources.text: Grand Theft Auto 6 is absolutely jam-packed with features, mini-games, activities, and collectibles. It can take hundreds of hours to see and do everything, so let’s see if two of the series’ most popular activities, darts and bowling, are somewhere in Vice City. Take out all the main story missions in GTA 6 , and you still have a ridiculously deep array of entertainment. Backyard Wrestling , Illegal Operations , and even meditating. But Rockstar wouldn’t cut two iconic games, right? You can buy Grand Theft Auto 6 here if you haven’t already! You can’t play Darts in GTA 6 as Rockstar Games has opted not to include the mini-game this time around. We all played a decent amount of Darts in GTA 4 and GTA 5, but that won’t be the case in GTA 6—for now. Darts is not one of GTA 6’s activities, so you’ll need to throw some real-life arrows for your fix. I’ll explain more about this below, but unless Rockstar Games adds Darts as a feature in GTA Online 2 multiplayer , the sport looks to be skipping a generation. Another recurring mini-game in the Grand Theft Auto franchise has been bowling, but bowling has been omitted from GTA 6 as well. You almost can’t complain about GTA 6 lacking features when it has so much. But you’d think Darts and Bowling would be dead-certs, especially with the game’s various bars and entertainment facilities. There’s a reason for this, though, and here’s what Rob Nelson, Rockstar North co-studio head, told IGN : “Darts was a contentious one. Even we… you hear they have unlimited money or unlimited time, even we do not and so sometimes you just have to admit we are not going to be able to make this to the level we feel we need to. A lot of work [is needed] to get it tuned right. Darts is one we just didn’t get to.” Are you sad that both have basically been cut?
